title: Inside the Earth
examples: What is the name of the Earth's solid outer layer?
Which layer is the hottest part of the Earth?
Is the mantle solid or liquid?

explain.say: The Earth has several layers going deep inside.
Now let me show you the real thing in 3D: the layers of the Earth. Look at the crust, the upper mantle and the lower mantle. Tap any part, and I will tell you what it does.
The crust is the thin, rocky layer we live on top of.
Next is the mantle, which is a thick layer below the crust.
The outer core is a layer of liquid metal surrounding the inner core.
The innermost layer is the solid inner core, made of strong metal.
Temperatures get hotter as you go deeper inside the Earth.

faq.a: The outer core is the layer that is liquid metal.
asks: What is the state of matter in the outer core?

faq.q: What is the crust made of?
faq.a: The crust is made of solid rock, and it is the thinnest layer.
asks: What is the composition of the crust?

faq.a: No, the outer core is liquid, while the inner core is solid.
The temperature increases greatly as you move from the crust to the inner core.
asks: Is it hotter at the center?

faq.q: What is the difference between the outer and inner core?
faq.a: The outer core is liquid metal, but the inner core is solid metal.
asks: What is the state of the inner core?

facts: The crust is the outermost layer of the Earth.
The mantle is mostly solid rock that moves very slowly.
The outer core is made of liquid iron and nickel.
The inner core is solid and is the hottest part.

quiz.why: The outer core is specifically described as being liquid metal.

wrong.0: The crust is the solid layer we live on.
wrong.1: The inner core is solid, not liquid.
wrong.2: While it flows, the mantle is not primarily liquid metal.

quiz.say: If you travel deeper, what happens to the temperature?
quiz.why: Heat from the Earth's center causes the temperature to rise steadily.

wrong.0: The heat source is deep inside the planet.
wrong.1: The core contains the planet's greatest heat.
wrong.3: Geothermal heat causes a steady increase in temperature.

quiz.say: The solid center of the Earth is called the:
quiz.why: The deepest, solid part of the Earth is the inner core.

wrong.0: The outer core is liquid, not solid.
wrong.1: The crust is the very thin surface layer.
wrong.3: The mantle is the layer above the core.
